name: ChatGPT / Codex
reason: ChatGPT is my first recommendation. For the way I work, the usage allowance feels generous and the connectivity is among the best. Most importantly, I like the interface. That is why I use Codex for development. Your actual limits depend on your plan and the work you give it.

name: Claude
reason: I think of Claude as the enterprise-oriented choice: a strong fit for large organizations and managed team workflows. My caution is cost, especially for heavy use. Compare the plan and any usage charges; the entry price alone does not tell you what your workload will cost.

name: Cursor
reason: I would point you toward Cursor if you are serious about getting into development as a whole, or interested in agents that work on longer tasks. It puts the editor and project workflow at the center. Check which cloud and long-running capabilities your plan includes.

name: Google / Gemini + Antigravity
reason: Google is the convenient choice if you are already paying for its storage or running your business in Workspace. Check what your existing plan includes before buying something else. Gemini, Spark, and Antigravity have different access rules; a storage or Workspace subscription does not automatically unlock all three.

name: GitHub
reason: Own durable project repositories and private progress.

name: GitHub Mobile
reason: Required in Phase 1. Sign into your GitHub account and confirm your profile opens.

name: Authenticator app
reason: Required in Phase 1, even when you usually use passkeys. I use Google Authenticator; an existing working authenticator counts.

name: Cloudflare
reason: Default deployment and domain platform in this workflow.

name: Neon
reason: Prepare relational-data access; create a database only when needed.

name: Google AI Studio
reason: One instant builder is required; existing Google access may be sufficient.

name: Lovable
reason: An alternative for the one required instant builder.

name: Base44
reason: An alternative for the one required instant builder.

name: Replit
reason: An alternative for the one required instant builder.

name: Vercel
reason: Alternate deployment option; check current plan suitability for your project.

name: Tailscale
reason: Phase 2 private networking; pair with a working interaction layer.
